# BTC500

> Free Bitcoin halving countdown and investment tools built around the BTC500 strategy: buy exactly 500 days before each Bitcoin halving and sell exactly 500 days after.

Site: https://btc500.net
Contact: btc500halving@gmail.com
X/Twitter: https://x.com/btc500halving
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/btc500halving

## What is BTC500?

BTC500 is a simple, rules-based Bitcoin investment approach timed to the ~4-year halving cycle:

1. Buy Bitcoin exactly 500 days before the next halving.
2. Hold through the halving.
3. Sell exactly 500 days after the halving.
4. Repeat each ~4-year cycle.

The site is free educational software with live countdowns, backtesting tools, on-chain indicators, and market data dashboards. Nothing on the site is financial advice.

## Key facts

- Next Bitcoin halving: projected for around April 2028, when block height reaches 1,050,000. Exact date depends on Bitcoin's average block time.
- Historical halvings:
  - 2012-11-28 — block 210,000
  - 2016-07-09 — block 420,000
  - 2020-05-11 — block 630,000
  - 2024-04-20 — block 840,000
- Halving frequency: every 210,000 blocks (~4 years); the block reward paid to miners is cut in half.
- BTC500 buy window: exactly 500 days before each halving.
- BTC500 sell window: exactly 500 days after each halving.
- Next BTC500 buy date: the current block-height estimate is November 28, 2026 (500 days before the estimated April 11, 2028 halving). The commonly cited consensus projection is November 30, 2026 for an April 13, 2028 halving. Both derive from block 1,050,000, so the exact day moves.
- Next BTC500 sell date: August 24, 2029 on the current estimate (August 26, 2029 on the consensus projection), 500 days after the halving.
- Calendar feed: the next buy, halving and sell dates as a downloadable .ics file at https://btc500.net/bitcoin-halving-calendar.ics
- 2024 BTC500 sell date: September 2, 2025 (500 days after the April 20, 2024 halving).
- The strategy finished higher at T+500 in every completed cycle (2012, 2016, 2020, 2024) based on historical Bitstamp prices. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

## FAQ

- What is the BTC500 strategy? Buy Bitcoin exactly 500 days before each halving and sell exactly 500 days after. This rules-based method captures historically strong parts of Bitcoin's ~4-year halving cycle without day-trading.
- When is the next Bitcoin halving? Projected for around April 2028 at block height 1,050,000. Exact date depends on average block time.
- When is 500 days before the next Bitcoin halving? The BTC500 buy date is 500 calendar days before the next estimated halving. The current block-height estimate is November 28, 2026 (the consensus April 13, 2028 projection gives November 30, 2026); it moves as block times drift. Live date: https://btc500.net/halving-dates. Calendar file: https://btc500.net/bitcoin-halving-calendar.ics
- When do you sell Bitcoin after a halving? Under BTC500, exactly 500 days after the halving. The 2024 halving sell date was September 2, 2025. The current block-height estimate for the next sell date is August 24, 2029 (August 26, 2029 on the consensus projection), and it moves with block times. Full table: https://btc500.net/when-to-sell-bitcoin-after-halving
- Should you sell Bitcoin before the halving? The BTC500 rule does not. It buys at T-500, holds through the halving, and sells at T+500. Selling early breaks the fixed window and the historical comparison.
- How does the halving work? Every 210,000 blocks (~4 years) the block reward is cut in half, reducing new supply. Lower issuance has historically coincided with multi-year price cycles.
- Has the strategy been profitable? In every completed cycle (2012, 2016, 2020, 2024) buying 500 days before and selling 500 days after finished higher. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
- Is the Bitcoin bottom in as of 21 August 2026? Yes — in the $54,000–$64,000 box. Closing low $58,566 on 30 June 2026. Soft-bull transition after the 19–20 August squeeze. Confirmation is a weekly hold above $71,500, then $78,000, then $82,000. Invalidation: weekly close back inside the box or below $58,566. The BTC500 buy date remains 30 November 2026. Not financial advice.
- Is BTC500 free? Yes. Countdown, simulator, timeline, dashboards, articles, and embed widgets are free with no account required.
- Is this financial advice? No. BTC500 is educational software and market data tooling.
